significance: A temple at Akaparambu in Ernakulam district where the Devi is the principal deity alongside Shiva and Sastha. A Thambula Prasna held in 2007 led to the installation of Brahmarakshas and Naga shrines the following year.
story: The goddess is said to owe her strength to the Brahmachari scholar Sankara Sarma, who moved his household worship of Bhadrakali to this temple before renouncing the world.
